```python
import shutil
import openpyxl

shutil.copy(INIT, OUT)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(OUT)
ws = wb.active
sheet_name = ws.title

vals = openpyxl.load_workbook(INIT, data_only=True)
vws = vals[sheet_name]

b2 = vws["B2"].value
expected = []

for r in range(4, 15):
    c = vws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    d = vws.cell(row=r, column=4).value

    formula = (
        f'=IF(OR($B$2<C{r},AND($B$2>=C{r},$B$2<=D{r})),'
        '"Select Period","Do Not Select")'
    )
    ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value = formula

    if b2 is not None and c is not None and d is not None:
        is_select = (b2 < c) or (c <= b2 <= d)
    else:
        is_select = False

    expected.append("Select Period" if is_select else "Do Not Select")

wb.save(OUT)

print("Sheet:", sheet_name)
print("B2:", b2)
print("Expected E4:E14:", expected)
```
